text:
maria: opening thread — about 02:40 UTC we started seeing a spike of SCIM 500s and SAML validation errors after the scheduled KMS key rotation. Some provisioning jobs created duplicate users and several audit_events are missing correlation_id.

dan: quick summary from logs: metadata push to idp-config-bucket returned 403 for ~90s (IAM role used by kms-roller lacked s3:PutObjectAcl). IdP continued serving cached SP certs -> signature mismatch.
deploy-bot: kms-rotate v2.2.0 by terry at 2025-06-03T02:38:12Z :rocket:

infra-bot: PUT idp-config-bucket/config.json -> AccessDenied at 02:39:01Z, retries succeeded at 02:40:35Z.

maria: impact: ~520 failed assertions, ~360 SCIM errors, ~26 duplicate users created by backfill. No evidence of data exfil. Audit gaps: ~120 events missing correlation ids in window 02:38-02:42.
oncall-sec: severity?
maria: medium — user-facing failures and compliance audit gaps.
dan: immediate mitigations applied: 1) fixed IAM role (added s3:PutObjectAcl), 2) re-pushed metadata and confirmed IdP refetch, 3) toggled PROVISION_BACKFILL_DEDUP=true to avoid new duplicates while we reconcile.

terry: added temporary guard in rotation code to verify ACL before marking rotation active and to wait for IdP ack. PR #920 queued.

audit-bot: filed SEC-9001 (postmortem) and SEC-9002 (audit backfill).

maria: DB reconciliation plan: dedupe users by externalId in window and backfill audit_events by mapping provisioning_req_id -> user_id from provisioning logs. Will require maintenance window and ops write perms.

dan: follow-ups: 1) add CI gate that verifies infra:rotations role has s3 PutObjectAcl, 2) require a canary verification step for KMS rotations that performs an end-to-end SAML+SCIM roundtrip, 3) add HMAC-signed SCIM webhooks to remove cookie/session coupling.

oncall-sec: also include role-perm tests: any IAM change affecting services that read secrets or push configs must run a smoke canary in staging. Assigning owners: SEC-9001 -> maria, SEC-9003 (playbook) -> terry.

maria: vuln note — audit shows sso-proxy uses older xmlsec; opening a separate PR to upgrade and include in next patch window.

terry: rolling postmortem in 24h. For now, closing thread once DB dedupe scheduled. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
